notes: Modified cash basis school district (Lincoln County Public Schools District No. 1, North Platte). Governmental data from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp4-5); beginning balance 10,053,009 is 'as restated' (General Fund 7,335,114 includes Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds). Transfers in/out 223,000 each (Activities Fund support). Business-type = School Nutrition Fund (receipts/disbursements and balances from fund schedule p15; agrees with p3 statement). Balance sheet uses the p3 Statement of Activities and Net Position, School District Total column (cash basis, no liabilities); total_liabilities null. Component unit School Foundation is excluded. 'Other local sources' 115,740 split using General Fund schedule p8 lines 1925 and 1911; 'Other sources' 455,394 split using fund schedules (Special Building disposal of real property 413,643; General Fund other nonrevenue 24,151; Cooperative nonrevenue 17,600). 'Pupils' 4,934,086 split into General Fund 3,420,782 and Activities Fund 1,513,304 per the fund columns on p4. Detail: no Exhibit N (General Fund by object) in the trimmed PDF, so General Fund spending detail is by program as printed on the budget schedule (not itemized by object). General Fund schedule counts transfers: 5200 Fund transfers in 660,000 (from Depreciation) and 8000 Activities Fund support 223,000 are shown as other financing; transfers from General Fund to Depreciation (935,932) and Employee Benefit (118,500) are hidden inside General Fund spending lines (the statement's General Fund column is lower than schedule plus those funds' spending by 1,053,935 = 1,054,432 - 497, where Depreciation Fund transfer to General Fund is 660,497 vs 660,000 received); recorded as a group contra line with review. The General Fund schedule federal lines do not add to its printed total (see report_discrepancies). Bond Fund prints no total receipts line. Read pages 1-21 of 21
